name: Shadow Lantern
description: Shadow-puppet theatre: a lamp-lit cloth screen with jointed lamp-black silhouettes and translucent dyed-leather figures (Tholu Bommalata, Karagiozis, Reiniger). Light mode: the screen is bright and the figures are dark. Alternate look of the mythic-tale template.

tokens.texture: Woven-screen grain, lamp hot-spot and flicker (Studio.kit.mythic.lamp), soft shadow halo when a puppet nears the screen
tokens.spacing: --u = 1% of short side; --gap; safe-area insets per format

motion.personality: Theatrical and rod-driven: puppets sway from pivot joints, slide in profile, step on twos; the lamp breathes
motion.notes: Figures stay in profile and move from joints (Studio.kit.mythic.puppet). Dyed-leather colours are translucent fills with an ink outline, never text.

contrast_checked: Below 4.5:1 (accent-3/paper 4.1:1): leaf, borders, shapes and display type 24px+ only; never body or caption text
suitable_for: night-time or dramatic retellings without a dark theme

validation.evidence: Contrast ratios computed from the stylesheet hex values with src/pipeline/colorscience.py (WCAG 2.x), 2026-11-23. Frame-reviewed in Playwright Chromium on Windows through the mythic-film scaffold; not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the M2 host.

avoid_for: detailed iconography that needs a frontal view
